lines.x: Ghana's Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 49.8 in October 2026 from 51.3 in the previous month, signaling a contraction in business activity as it dropped below the 50-point threshold.
The International Monetary Fund has disbursed the final $371 million tranche of its $3 billion Extended Credit Facility for Ghana.
Government Statistician Dr Alhassan Iddrisu warned that Ghana could face fresh inflationary pressures from an anticipated severe El Niño weather event.
Ghana has ruled out issuing new sovereign Eurobonds until 2030 under its updated debt management strategy, prioritizing domestic and alternative financing sources.
